title: API: request/response schema v2 - deprecations, beta headers, backward-compat shims
author: Lena Park
description: Motivation: We need to introduce a v2 request/response schema to support typed structured output frames, more robust tool/function calling payloads, and clearer streaming semantics while preserving a migration path for existing customers and OpenAI-compat integrations. This PR surfaces the v2 schema behind an opt-in beta header, implements server-side backcompat shims for the most common v1 patterns, and adds deprecation warnings + telemetry. Summary of changes: 1) New schema files: api/schema/v2/*.json describing the canonical v2 request and response shapes (structured output/frame types, explicit tool call envelopes, and clearer streaming markers). 2) Beta opt-in header: support for X-Redwood-API-Version and X-Redwood-API-Beta. Clients can opt into v2 by setting X-Redwood-API-Version: 2026-02 or X-Redwood-API-Beta: schema_v2. 3) Backcompat shims: server-side transformers (pkg/compat/backcompat_shims.go) that convert common v1 payloads into v2 canonical forms and downgrade v2 responses to v1 shapes for non-opted-in clients. 4) OpenAI-compat updates: the openai_compat layer now transparently maps OpenAI-style function call payloads to the v2 tool/call envelope and vice-versa; added heuristics for legacy function_call: 'none' | 'auto' semantics. 5) Streaming stability: clarified streaming protocol in v2 (chunk envelope with "frame_type" keys; final frame has "frame_type"="done"); implemented graceful fallback to v1 event-stream (data: lines) for legacy clients. 6) Contract tests & CI: new end-to-end compatibility tests to cover common v1 patterns + random fuzzed messages to validate shims. Migration notes: - Opt-in first: no automatic switch. Customers should set the beta header and validate their workloads. - Deprecation timeline: v1 fields listed in docs/migration/api-schema-v2.md will be deprecated; full removal planned after a 6-month beta and customer outreach. - Known gaps: very custom v1 streaming consumers that rely on ad-hoc whitespace framing should migrate to the new frame_type protocol; shims attempt to preserve payloads but may change ordering semantics for some edge cases. Checklists:/n- [x] Add v2 JSON schema and examples/n- [x] Implement beta header parsing and opt-in routing/n- [x] Implement backcompat shims for requests and responses/n- [x] Update openai_compat layer mapping/n- [x] Add contract tests and CI pipeline entries/n- [x] Add migration docs and release notes How we validated: unit tests for transformers, integration tests hitting the compatibility layer with both v1 and v2 clients, manual smoke tests with Redwood SDKs (python/ts) to ensure behavior parity, and load-tested streaming paths for stability. Related: ENG-5123 (schema v2 design), ENG-5187 (streaming stability fixes), SUP-2211 (customer report: function_call truncation).
commits: feat(api): add schema v2 JSON files and canonical examples
feat(server): beta header parsing, routing, and schema selection
feat(compat): backcompat shims for request/response translation
fix(openai_compat): map OpenAI function_call envelopes to v2 tool/call types
feat(streaming): add frame_type envelope and fallback to v1 event-stream
test: add contract tests for v1<->v2 conversions and streaming
docs: migration guide and deprecation notes
chore(ci): add compatibility pipeline job and flaky-test tolerances
review_comments:
Rafael: Overall looks good. Two asks: (1) Can we be explicit about error codes when shims drop unsupported fields? I suggest returning 422 for payload mismatches rather than 500. (2) Add a toggle in Dedicated to disable shims for customers who want strict mode.
Lena: Addressed both. Added 422 mappings and a config flag shim.disable_inference_shims in server/handlers/schema_version.go; updated docs.

Priya: Please add more examples for streamed tool output where a function emits multiple partial frames. Concern: client SDKs need clear guidance on reassembly.
Lena: Added reassembly guidance to docs and sample code in sdk/python and sdk/typescript. Kept shims to coalesce partial frames if client is v1 to preserve previous behavior.

Avery: Are we emitting telemetry for dropped fields so we can decide on final deprecations? Also, confirm CI covers OpenAI-compat contract.
Lena: Yes - added telemetry event api.schema.v2.shim.drop_field with counts and payload hashes. CI job added: compatibility/pipeline which runs OpenAI-compat matrix.
Priya (LGTM): small nits fixed in follow-up commit. Rafael (Approved): merge after CI green. Avery (Approved): merge.
release_notes: Introduces v2 API request/response schema behind a beta header. Server provides backcompat shims to ease migration; see docs/migration/api-schema-v2.md. v1 fields will be deprecated over a 6-month window after beta stabilization. OpenAI-compat layer updated to map function_call envelopes to v2 tool/call types.
merge_commit_message: squash: API schema v2 + backcompat shims (ENG-5123, ENG-5187)
notes_for_ops: Ops: feature gate shim.disable_inference_shims can be toggled per-cluster. Add telemetry index for api.schema.v2.* events. Rolling restart recommended after deploy to ensure schema selector warmed. Monitor compatibility/pipeline dashboard for regressions.
